overview: The commission found 130 Boston Avenue preferably preserved and determined the historical significance of several other residential and commercial properties. The body also voted on lifting demolition delays for specific projects and supported the relocation of the Sarah Bradley Fulton historical marker.

items.title: 130 Boston Avenue Preferably Preserved Hearing
items.summary: Voted to find the property preferably preserved, imposing an 18-month demolition delay due to its association with architect Moses Mann. The commission invited the owner to work with a subcommittee to potentially lift the delay earlier than 18 months.

items.title: Demolition Applications
items.summary: Accepted demolition applications for 10 Newcomb Street, 85 Fern Road, 50 Winthrop Street, and 2-4 Capen Street; an application for 80 Canal Street was not received.

items.title: 43 Wright Avenue
items.summary: Voted to pass on demolition review after reconsidering the application and determining the proposed roof changes did not warrant a delay.

items.title: Determinations of Historical Significance
items.summary: Determined 20 Otis Street and 76 Sharon Street historically significant, while failing to find 136 Boston Avenue and 4054 Mystic Valley Parkway significant.

items.title: 17 Edward Street Demolition Delay
items.summary: Approved lifting the demolition delay contingent upon the homeowner submitting the final architectural plans to the permitting system.

items.title: 78 Codding Street Demolition Delay and Local Historic District
items.summary: Voted to lift the demolition delay based on revised designs and stated opposition to the creation of a single-property local historic district against the owner's wishes.

items.title: Sarah Bradley Fulton Historic Marker Relocation
items.summary: Voted to support the conceptual relocation of the marker from the DPW yard to a pedestrian-accessible site on Main Street near the Mystic River.

items.title: Commission Updates, CPA Projects, and Minutes
items.summary: Welcomed new member Joseph Ronin and reviewed the ongoing archaeological dig at Thomas Brooks Park and the FY23 budget match requirements for state grants. The commission approved the May 2022 meeting minutes.

items.title: 15 Hadley Place Demolition Delay
items.summary: Voted not to lift the 18-month demolition delay early, despite the owner's revised plan to preserve the existing house as a duplex.
